questions.text: How many 3-digit numbers exist whose sum of digits is equal to 4?

What part of this figure is black?
There are 108 seats in a passenger plane. There is one vacant seat for every two passengers. How many passengers are there on the plane?
Harry has 3 sisters and 5 brothers. His sister Sally has X sisters and Y brothers. What is the product of X and Y?
Someone takes a natural number. He doubles that number, doubles the result again, doubles another time and once again. Which of the following numbers can certainly not be the result?

Nicky and Stephanie are running around a stadium. Nicky needs 3 minutes for one lap, while Stephanie needs 4 minutes for one lap. They started simultaneously. In how many minutes will they first pass the start line simultaneously?

For an athletic competition only those boys who can run 10 kilometers will be nominated. Johnny managed to run 9941 meters and 5456 centimeters and then he stopped totally exhausted and unable to continue. By how many centimeters did he miss the finish line?
What is the number of the last wagon of the kangaroo's train?
Would the red dragon have 6 heads more than the green one, they would have 34 heads altogether. But the red dragon has 6 heads less than the green one. How many heads does the red dragon have?
The length of one rectangular field is 80 m and the area is 3200 m². Find the length of another rectangle whose area and width are both half of the first one's.

It took Stephanie exactly an hour to do all her homework. She spent a third of the time with mathematics and two fifths of the remaining time with geography. How much time in minutes did she spend preparing for all other subjects?
Three years ago were the triplets Paul, Simon, Bill and their four years elder sister Stavria. The ages all together sum up to 24 years. How old is Stavria?

During their holidays Albert, Brett and Chris together earned 280 Euro. Albert has worked twice as long as Brett and four times as long as Chris. They decided to share their earnings fairly. How much euro did Chris get?

One of the biggest attractions of a funfair is the Big Wheel. The cabins are equally spaced and numbered 1, 2, 3, .... In the moment when cabin no. 25 reaches its lowest position, cabin no. 8 reaches its highest position. How many cabins are there on this attraction?

On a common dice the sum of the values at opposite faces is always seven. Cecilia builds a solid out of six equally sized common dice by gluing them together, one on top of the other. What is the maximal number of dots that she can obtain on the surface of this six-dice solid?
Through the big cube, tunnels have been cut out as indicated. How many little cubes remain in the big one?
The star shown in the picture has been drawn using the middle points of the sides of a regular hexagon. If the area of the star is 6, what is the area of the hexagon?
All the following solids have the same volume. Which one has the largest surface area?

Using the digits 1 to 6 you can form two three-digit numbers, for example 645 and 321. These numbers differ by 324. Now form two three-digit numbers whose difference is as small as possible. What is the smallest possible difference?
Put one of these numbers 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 in each box so that the addition is correct. What is the value of this addition result equal to A?
